skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 3 combo hits, dealing 180% ATK (+2) DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict [Field] on the target for 1 turn (before acting, takes DoT equal to 60% ATK, with a 50% chance to penetrate immunity effects).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with 3 combo hits, dealing 180% ATK (+2) DMG, with a 100% chance to inflict [Field] on the target for 1 turn (before acting, takes DoT equal to 70% ATK, with a 50% chance to penetrate immunity effects).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self HP. At the start of battle, permanently grants a 20% DoT Boost to self and allies in the same row, and grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 20% of own HP).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self HP. At the start of battle, permanently grants a 25% DoT Boost to self and allies in the same row, and grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 25% of own HP).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self HP. At the start of battle, permanently grants a 30% DoT Boost to self and allies in the same row, and grants self [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 30% of own HP).

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
